critical_checks.evidence: Seven traceable small-molecule histories span target/design, optimization, phenotypic screening and repurposing, including DSP-1181, EXS21546 and REC-994 discontinuation. Candidate/indication/formulation is the unit of progress. Current trial-registry modules R01W–R06, original papers AIDD-S01/S02/S11–15/S20 and AIDD04/06/08 support the principal chains; partnership examples resolve deliverables, rights, experiments and downstream responsibility. No causal industry-wide uplift follows from this selected set.

Complete English longitudinal report with a seven-program register, arm-level safety and separate FVC estimators, clinical-trial comparison, stage-specific synthesis and partnership/decision analysis. Full continuous reading covered every substantive line; no outline-only or abbreviated substitute.

Registry JSON distinguishes oral phase III first posting 2026-07-07, actual start 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-10 dosing announcement; inhalation IND remains separate. REC-994 later registry results do not undo its 2025 stop. REC-4881 2026-11-02 release uses a 2026-09-10 data cutoff; planned 2027 activity is not completed development. Original 2026-10-15 Sanofi release establishes a candidate option and future phase I plan, not clinical benefit. Sources used to establish stage predate 2026-11-09.

AIDD-S02:119–150,170–184; S23 Table 2:33–96; actual Figure 2 PNG panels a/b; R01W absolute-FVC registered results. Randomization 18/18/18/17, missing week-12 measurements 5/6/8/3, observed high-dose/placebo n=10/14 and modeled randomized n=18/17 are distinct. 118.7 and 97.4 mL are explicitly descriptive group-mean subtractions, not estimated contrast CIs. AE-related discontinuations 1/5/4/2 and liver/background-therapy caution agree with originals.

AIDD06:184–202,270–305 supports nomination in under 12 months excluding safety, 350 compounds and repeated approximately two-week cycles. AIDD08:232–249 supports the disclosed stop criterion. R04/R05 separate healthy-volunteer and six-patient oncology studies; the registry therapeutic-index reason is not erased as merely financial. AIDD-S20:185–193 and R03 results retain REC-994's negative development decision and noncomparable safety exposure. Issuer REC-4881 meeting slides p6/p9 and 2026-11-02 release support 21 phase-II patients,16 evaluable,15 week-13 and13 week-25 measurements,26 safety patients and explicit open-label limitations.

AIDD-S11/S12/S13 retain ACTT-2, COV-BARRIER and RECOVERY designs, endpoints and denominators; failed primary COV-BARRIER progression is not replaced by nominal secondary mortality. AIDD04 separates old SU3327 structure, retrospective AUC, selected prospective 51/99 and2/63 samples,23 ZINC tests/8 active against any species and preclinical limitations. Jayatunga et al. original author-posted article at 504–595 and figure caption 803–806 supports 21/24 and4/10 in a broader AI-native cohort, excluding COVID-related molecules; descriptive Wilson intervals do not become causal comparative evidence.

Takeda license in Recursion 2025 10-K supports worldwide rights/nonclinical license-back and separated payment types. Sanofi 2022 filed 6-K:77–93 and contract clauses20–22 distinguish $100m upfront,~$343m/program,~$5.2bn ceiling, partner development costs, platform IP and restricted data use. The 2026-10-15 issuer release supports $10m option trigger and $144m cumulative receipts, not an asset's standalone value. Roche original8-K:98–115 and January2022 subsequent-event note distinguish map/raw-image/program options and $150m received. Current report draws bounded implications from these terms.
